title: Fix N+1 member loading in BlockDetailsScreen
objective: Replace sequential per-member awaits in BlockDetailsScreen member loading with concurrent fetching while preserving loading and error state behavior.
acceptance_criteria: BlockDetailsScreen member loading no longer awaits membersRepo.getByIdAsync inside a sequential loop
Member entity fetches are dispatched concurrently with Future.wait or an equivalent concurrent pattern
Existing placeholder fallback behavior for missing member entities is preserved
Existing mounted guard around post-await setState behavior is preserved
Pull-to-refresh still reloads both members and meetings
flutter analyze for the block details feature reports no new errors
